title: Imagining Tomorrow's Entertainment
caption:
10 episodes, 22 to 30 minutes each
Buzzie Nominee, Most Innovative Factual Program/Project of the Year (World Congress of Science and Factual Producers)

Professor Eric R. Williams walks through where entertainment is headed with extended reality: esports, mixed reality sports, interactive storytelling, cinematic VR, the metaverse. He meets the people building it along the way.

I was the sole editor and did some of the graphics. The footage came from all over: 3D objects, 360 cameras, unrendered VR animations and environments, plus cameras of every kind from internal teams and freelance directors and operators shooting around the country. Getting all of that to sit together in one cut took a lot of problem solving and a lot of late nights.

It was also a blast to work on. Maybe because of the hard parts, honestly. I learned a ton on this one, and I still use it today.
